description: OpenCode Support - Add OpenCode as an alternative AI tool for loop execution with full feature parity

userStories.title: Add --opencode and --claude CLI flags
userStories.description: As a user, I want to specify which AI tool to use via command-line flags so that I can choose between Claude Code and OpenCode.
acceptanceCriteria: ./angainor.sh --opencode sets AI_TOOL variable to 'opencode'
./angainor.sh --claude explicitly sets AI_TOOL to 'claude'
Default behavior (no flag) uses 'claude' for backward compatibility
Flags work in combination with existing flags (--prd, --objective, max_iterations)
Usage comment at top of script updated to document new flags
Startup message shows which AI tool is selected
Typecheck passes (shellcheck on angainor.sh)

userStories.title: Create run_claude function to encapsulate Claude Code invocation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the existing Claude Code invocation logic extracted into a function so that it can be called from a tool abstraction layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Create run_claude() function that takes prompt_file and transcript_file as arguments
Function executes: claude --dangerously-skip-permissions --print < prompt_file
Function applies timeout protection (gtimeout/timeout with CLAUDE_TIMEOUT)
Function captures output to transcript_file using tee
Function sets OUTPUT and CLAUDE_EXIT_CODE variables
Existing loop behavior unchanged (refactor only, no new features)
Typecheck passes (shellcheck)
userStories.notes: Extract existing inline code into function before adding OpenCode

userStories.title: Create run_opencode function for OpenCode invocation
userStories.description: As the system, I need to invoke OpenCode with the correct command and flags so that prompts execute in non-interactive autonomous mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Create run_opencode() function with same interface as run_claude()
Function executes: opencode run "$(cat prompt_file)"
Function applies same timeout protection as Claude Code
Function captures output to transcript_file using tee
Function sets OUTPUT and CLAUDE_EXIT_CODE variables (same interface)
Typecheck passes (shellcheck)
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 (function interface must be established first)

userStories.title: Create run_ai_tool dispatcher function
userStories.description: As a developer, I want tool invocation abstracted so that the main loop calls a single function regardless of which AI tool is selected.
acceptanceCriteria: Create run_ai_tool() function that dispatches to run_claude or run_opencode
Dispatch based on AI_TOOL variable value ('claude' or 'opencode')
Main loop calls run_ai_tool instead of inline Claude invocation
Error message if AI_TOOL is set to unknown value
Existing behavior unchanged when using Claude Code
Typecheck passes (shellcheck)

userStories.description: As the system, I need to verify OpenCode is installed and configured before starting the loop so that users get clear error messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create validate_opencode() function called when AI_TOOL='opencode'
Check 'opencode' command exists in PATH
Check opencode.json exists in script directory

userStories.title: Create OpenCode setup helper script
userStories.description: As a user, I want an easy way to configure my API key and model selection for OpenCode so that I can get started quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/setup-opencode.sh
Script checks if opencode command is installed, provides install URL if not
Script prompts for API provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Other)
Script prompts for API key
Script prompts for model name with sensible defaults
Script creates opencode.json with permission: allow and model config
Script runs 'opencode run "echo test"' to validate setup works
Script is executable (chmod +x)
Typecheck passes (shellcheck)

userStories.title: Apply retry logic to OpenCode invocations
userStories.description: As the system, I need to retry OpenCode invocations on transient errors so that temporary API issues don't halt the loop.
acceptanceCriteria: run_opencode() output checked for transient errors (same patterns as Claude)
Retry up to MAX_RETRIES (3) times with exponential backoff
Log retry attempts: 'Calling OpenCode API (attempt N/3)...'
Transient error patterns include: rate limit, timeout, connection errors, 5xx
Record failure in metrics if all retries exhausted
Typecheck passes (shellcheck)
userStories.notes: Modify run_opencode to match existing retry behavior in main loop
